import sys,json,hashlib,argparse
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();run=root/'.agent-runs/performance-v2'
label,seed,model,budget=sys.argv[1],int(sys.argv[2]),sys.argv[3],sys.argv[4]
source=run/f'feature-timer-{label}'
sys.path.insert(0,str(source));sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'benchmarks'))
import numpy as np
import sklearn_genetic
assert Path(sklearn_genetic.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(source.resolve())
import benchmark_native_automl as benchmark
original_dataset=benchmark.dataset
provenance=json.loads((run/'datasets/drybean-provenance.json').read_text())
assert hashlib.sha256((run/'datasets/drybean.npz').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==provenance['npz_sha256']
def dataset(name):
 if name!='drybean':return original_dataset(name)
 data=np.load(run/'datasets/drybean.npz')
 return data['X'],data['y'],True
benchmark.dataset=dataset
traces=[]
def capture(original):
 def fit(self,*args,**kwargs):
  result=original(self,*args,**kwargs)
  field='features' if isinstance(self,sklearn_genetic.GAFeatureSelectionCV) else 'params'
  candidates=self.cv_results_[field]
  if field=='features':candidates=[np.asarray(v,dtype=int).tolist() for v in candidates]
  trace=dict(candidates=candidates,scores=list(map(float,self.cv_results_['mean_test_score'])))
  traces.append(dict(candidate_scores_sha256=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(trace,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),history=self.history,first_candidate=candidates[0],cache_hits=self.fit_stats_['cache_hits']))
  return result
 return fit
for cls in [sklearn_genetic.GASearchCV,sklearn_genetic.GAFeatureSelectionCV]:cls.fit=capture(cls.fit)
control=budget.startswith('control_');method=budget.split('_',1)[1] if control else 'features'
if control:
 import sklearn_genetic.callbacks as callbacks
 callbacks.TimerStopping=lambda seconds:None
output=run/f'feature-timer-{label}-{model}-{budget}-{seed}.json'
args=argparse.Namespace(evolutionary_model=model,methods=[method],label=label,seconds=3600 if control else float(budget),seeds=1,seed_start=seed,train_fraction=1.,generations=0 if control else 1000,finalists=4,output=output,model_dir=run/'unused-models',datasets=['breast','digits','diabetes','synthetic']+([] if control else ['drybean']))
benchmark.run(args)
data=json.loads(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'));assert len(data['results'])==len(traces)
for row,trace in zip(data['results'],traces):row.update(trace)
data['settings'].update(timer_enabled=not control,budget_regime=budget)
data['drybean_provenance']=provenance
output.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')

import itertools,json,hashlib,math,statistics as st
from pathlib import Path
r=Path('.agent-runs/performance-v2');rows=[];profiles={}
configs=list(itertools.product(['svm','lightgbm'],['1','5'],range(2201,2204)))+[('svm',b,2204) for b in ['control_features','control_gasearch']]
sizes={'breast':30,'digits':64,'diabetes':10,'synthetic':80,'drybean':16}
for label in ['baseline','current']:
 for model,budget,seed in configs:
  data=json.loads((r/f'feature-timer-{label}-{model}-{budget}-{seed}.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));control=budget.startswith('control_')
  datasets=set(sizes)-({'drybean'} if control else set())
  assert len(data['results'])==len(datasets) and {v['dataset'] for v in data['results']}==datasets
  profiles[f'{label}/{model}/{budget}/{seed}']={k:v for k,v in data.items() if k!='results'}
  assert data['settings']['timer_enabled']==(not control)
  for row in data['results']:
   assert row['seed']==seed and row['method']==(budget.split('_',1)[1] if control else 'features')
   assert row['requested_seconds']==(3600 if control else float(budget))
   assert row['promotion_cv_calls']==0 and row['train_fold_sizes']==row['full_fold_sizes']
   assert row['evaluations']>0 and row['seconds']>0 and math.isfinite(row['cv_score']) and math.isfinite(row['holdout_score'])
   assert row['generations']==len(row['history']['gen'])
   assert all(a<=b for a,b in zip(row['history']['fitness_best'],row['history']['fitness_best'][1:]))
   if control:assert row['generations']==1 and row['evaluations']<=8
   if row['method']=='features':
    assert len(row['selected_mask'])==sizes[row['dataset']] and 1<=sum(row['selected_mask'])<=sizes[row['dataset']]
    assert row['selected_features']==sum(row['selected_mask'])
    assert sum(row['first_candidate'])==(sizes[row['dataset']] if label=='current' and not control else 1)
   else:
    assert row['selected_mask'] is None
   if row['dataset']=='drybean':assert row['train_samples']==10208 and row['test_samples']==3403
   rows.append(dict(variant=label,model=model,budget_regime=budget,**row))
assert len(rows)==136
pairs={}
for row in rows:
 key=(row['dataset'],row['seed'],row['model'],row['budget_regime']);assert row['variant'] not in pairs.setdefault(key,{})
 pairs[key][row['variant']]=row
assert len(pairs)==68
for key,pair in pairs.items():
 if key[-1].startswith('control_'):
  a,b=pair['baseline'],pair['current']
  for field in ['candidate_scores_sha256','cv_score','holdout_score','selected_params','selected_mask','evaluations','cache_hits','history']:assert a[field]==b[field],(key,field)
manifest=json.loads((r/'feature-timer-source-sha256.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
for label,paths in manifest.items():
 for path,sha in paths.items():assert hashlib.sha256((r/f'feature-timer-{label}'/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha,path
payload=dict(base_commit='dac3879d15a26764f2107a133a2f11065c2a0192',source_sha256=manifest,profiles=profiles,results=rows)
(r/'feature-timer-combined.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
lines=['PASS136 finite fits /68pairs; source hashes, folds, budgets, first masks, nonempty/bounded winners and monotonic best fitness verified. No-timer feature/HPO controls preserve exact search hashes, complete histories, scores, winners and counters.',f'Total measured fit seconds: {sum(row["seconds"] for row in rows):.3f}','| Model | Seconds | Dataset | Baseline score / elapsed / features / CV calls | Dense-first score / elapsed / features / CV calls | Holdout delta | Error ratio |','|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|']
for model,budget,dataset in itertools.product(['svm','lightgbm'],['1','5'],sizes):
 groups=[[row for row in rows if row['variant']==label and row['model']==model and row['budget_regime']==budget and row['dataset']==dataset] for label in ['baseline','current']]
 assert all(len(group)==3 for group in groups)
 mean=lambda g,k:st.mean(v[k] for v in g)
 cells=[f'{mean(g,"holdout_score"):.6f} / {mean(g,"seconds"):.3f} / {mean(g,"selected_features"):.1f} / {mean(g,"evaluations"):.1f}' for g in groups]
 a,b=[mean(g,'holdout_score') for g in groups];ratio=a/b if dataset=='diabetes' else (1-a)/(1-b)
 lines.append(f'| {model} | {budget} | {dataset} | {cells[0]} | {cells[1]} | {b-a:+.6f} | {ratio:.3f} |')
 lines.append('Score SD: '+', '.join(f'{st.stdev(v["holdout_score"] for v in g):.6f}' for g in groups))
text='\n'.join(lines)+'\n';(r/'feature-timer-summary.txt').write_text(text,encoding='utf-8');print(text)
